name: Nobunaga mo Hideyoshi mo Ieyasu mo!? Minna Harabote de Tenka Touitsu!!
original_name: 信長も秀吉も家康も！？　み～んな腹ボテで天下統一！！
source:
I fell down a manhole and somehow ended up in the fields of battle-torn Old Japan.
...But there was something weird about this world.
Everyone I knew from the history books, they were all here... but they're cute girls!? 

Hideyoshi captured me and I was enslaved in Nobunaga's camp. Then by chance, I got my hands on a very special fan, which makes any girl wild for me by waving it. 
"Marvelous. Your copious cum will flood the insides of our enemies. Go forth and conquer, my engorged foot soldier!"
Yessir! I said. Yesma'am! Enjoy your reign of power while it lasts, Nobu-chan. I'm going to turn this jetblast of jizzum on you eventually... 

Screw history... this era belongs to me!!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE103112.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我掉进下水道，莫名其妙地来到了战火纷飞的旧日本战场。

……但这个世界有些不对劲。

历史书上的熟人全都出现在这里，可他们竟然都是可爱的女孩！？

秀吉俘虏了我，把我变成信长阵营的奴隶。后来我偶然得到一把特殊的扇子，只要挥动它，任何女孩都会对我狂热。

“太棒了！你那取之不尽的精液会淹没敌人的内部。前进吧，胀大的步兵，去征服一切！”

“是！”我回答道。

趁你的权势还没有结束，好好享受吧，信长酱。我迟早会把这股精液喷流用在你身上……

去他的历史……这个时代属于我！！
